title: The Samaritan Woman
subtitle: Jesus offers living water to an abandoned woman

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: Jesus was traveling from Judea to Galilee and had to pass through Samaria. It was hot noon.

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: Jesus sat by a well. A Samaritan woman came alone to draw water.

steps.speaker: Jesus
steps.text: Please, give me some water to drink.

steps.speaker: Samaritan Woman
steps.text: How is it that you, being a Jew, ask water from me, a Samaritan woman? Jews don't have dealings with us.
Why was the woman surprised by Jesus' request?
options: Because Jews generally avoided Samaritans
Because she was afraid of water
Because it was night and there shouldn't be men

steps.speaker: Jesus
steps.text: If you knew who I am, you would ask me for water. I would give you living water that would never run dry.

steps.speaker: Samaritan Woman
steps.text: Living water? Sir, you don't even have a bucket and the well is deep. How can you draw living water?

steps.speaker: Jesus
steps.text: Anyone who drinks this water will be thirsty again. But whoever drinks the water I give will never be thirsty again.

steps.speaker: Samaritan Woman
steps.text: Sir, give me this water so I will not be thirsty or have to come here to draw water!
What did the woman ask of Jesus?
options: The living water that Jesus offered
More gold and silver
That he come back another day
steps.answer: The living water that Jesus offered

steps.speaker: Jesus
steps.text: Go call your husband and come back.

steps.speaker: Samaritan Woman
steps.text: I have no husband.

steps.speaker: Jesus
steps.text: You are right. You have had five husbands and the one you now have is not your husband. You have spoken the truth.
The woman realized that Jesus knew her entire story. She had been hurt and rejected many times. But Jesus did not judge her.
steps.speaker: Narrator
Samaritan Woman
steps.text: Sir, you are a prophet! Now I understand that you are the Messiah we have been waiting for!

steps.speaker: Jesus
steps.text: I am he. True worship is not on mountains or in temples, but in spirit and in truth.
How was the woman transformed?
options: She recognized Jesus as the Messiah and testified to others
She continued with the same empty life
She tried to deceive Jesus
steps.answer: She recognized Jesus as the Messiah and testified to others

steps.speaker: Samaritan Woman
steps.text: People of my city! Come! I found the Messiah! He knows me! See what he did for me!
Many Samaritans believed in Jesus through that woman's testimony. Her life was transformed by the love of Jesus.
steps.speaker: Narrator

title: The Prodigal Son
subtitle: The love of a father who never abandons

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: A certain man had two sons. One day, the younger son said to his father: 'Father, give me my inheritance now!'

steps.speaker: Father
steps.text: My son, you want your inheritance already? Very well. I will divide my property.

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: The younger son took his inheritance and went far away. He lived wildly, spending everything on parties and pleasures.
How did the younger son use his inheritance?
options: He spent it all on parties and pleasures
He invested in business
He saved and invested carefully
steps.answer: He spent it all on parties and pleasures

steps.speaker: Younger Son
steps.text: Finally I'm free! No one can tell me what to do! I will enjoy life!
But when the money ran out, a great famine came to the land. The son had nothing.
steps.speaker: Narrator
Younger Son
steps.text: I'm dying of hunger! I need a job! What can I do?

steps.speaker: Employer
steps.text: You can work taking care of my pigs. You will feed the pigs.
The fallen son began to feed the pigs. He was so hungry that he would have eaten what the pigs ate.
steps.speaker: Narrator

steps.text: What was the son's situation when the money ran out?
options: He was without anything, working with pigs, hungry
He found a well-paid job
His father found him and took him back
steps.answer: He was without anything, working with pigs, hungry

steps.speaker: Younger Son
steps.text: What a fool I was! My father has many servants and they all have enough food. But I'm here dying of hunger.

steps.speaker: Younger Son
steps.text: I will go back to my father. I will say: Father, I have sinned against you. I am not worthy to be your son. Let me be one of your servants.
The son got up and began the long journey back. He was repentant and humiliated.
steps.speaker: Narrator
Narrator
steps.text: But when still far away, his father saw him. The father's heart overflowed with love and compassion.

steps.speaker: Father
steps.text: My son! My son has come back! The one I thought was lost is now found!

steps.speaker: Father
steps.text: Quick! Bring the best clothes! Prepare a great feast! My son is back!
How did the father respond when he saw his son return?
options: With love and forgiveness, offering a feast
With anger and punishment
With indifference
steps.answer: With love and forgiveness, offering a feast

steps.speaker: Younger Son
steps.text: Father! I have sinned against you! I am not worthy to be your son...

steps.speaker: Father
steps.text: Hush, my son! You have come back! That is all that matters! You were lost and now you are found!

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: The father embraced his son and kissed him. All the joy of the home was restored. God loves us in the same way.

title: The Resurrection of Lazarus
subtitle: Jesus has power even over death

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: Lazarus was a friend of Jesus. He lived in Bethany with his sisters Mary and Martha. One day, Lazarus became very ill.

steps.speaker: Mary
steps.text: Martha, Lazarus is getting worse! We must send word to Jesus! He can heal him!

steps.speaker: Martha
steps.text: Yes! Let's send someone right away! Jesus loves him. When he hears that Lazarus is sick, he will come running!
Why did Mary and Martha want Jesus to know Lazarus was sick?
options: Because they trusted that Jesus could heal him
Because they wanted Jesus to suffer
Because they had no money for doctors
steps.answer: Because they trusted that Jesus could heal him

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: The sisters sent a message, but Jesus did not go immediately. He waited two days before traveling.
When Jesus arrived, Lazarus had been dead for four days. Martha came out to meet him.
steps.speaker: Narrator
Martha
steps.text: Lord! If you had come when Lazarus was sick, he would not have died! But even now, I know God listens to you always!

steps.speaker: Jesus
steps.text: Your brother will rise again.

steps.speaker: Martha
steps.text: I know he will rise again in the resurrection, on the last day.

steps.speaker: Jesus
steps.text: I am the resurrection and the life. Whoever believes in me, though he die, yet shall he live. Do you believe this?
What did Jesus promise about himself?
options: That He is the resurrection and the life
That no one would die
That He would reign for a thousand years
steps.answer: That He is the resurrection and the life

steps.speaker: Martha
steps.text: Yes, Lord! I believe that you are the Christ, the Son of God!
Jesus asked them to take him to Lazarus' tomb. The stone was rolled away.
steps.speaker: Narrator
Jesus
steps.text: Father, I thank you for hearing me. Father, raise Lazarus!
Lazarus came out of the tomb! His arms and legs were bound with wrappings and his face was covered with a cloth.
steps.speaker: Narrator
Jesus
steps.text: Loose him and let him go! He is alive!

steps.speaker: Mary and Martha
steps.text: Lazarus! You came back! Jesus gave our brother back to us!
How did Jesus raise Lazarus?
options: By prayer and God's power
Through medical techniques
By magic

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: All who saw the miracle believed in Jesus. Death could not hold back before God's power.

title: The Road to Emmaus
subtitle: We recognize Jesus when he reveals himself

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: After Jesus' crucifixion, two disciples were walking on the road to Emmaus. They were sad and confused.

steps.speaker: Disciple 1
steps.text: We had hope that Jesus was the Messiah. But he was crucified. Now everything is lost.

steps.speaker: Disciple 2
steps.text: Yes. And women said his tomb is empty. How can this be? Where will salvation come from now?

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: As they talked, a man approached and began to walk with them. It was the risen Jesus, but their eyes were veiled.

steps.speaker: Jesus
steps.text: What do you discuss as you walk? You seem sad.
Are you a stranger? Don't you know what happened in Jerusalem?
steps.speaker: Disciple 1

steps.text: Why didn't the disciples recognize Jesus?
options: Because their eyes were veiled by God
Because Jesus had changed clothes
Because it was too dark
steps.answer: Because their eyes were veiled by God

steps.speaker: Disciple 2
steps.text: Tell us what happened. A man named Jesus of Nazareth was mighty in deeds. But the leaders crucified him.

steps.speaker: Jesus
steps.text: O foolish ones! Slow of heart to believe! Was it not necessary that the Christ should suffer and enter his glory?

steps.speaker: Jesus
steps.text: Beginning with Moses and all the prophets, he interpreted to them in all the Scriptures the things about himself.
As they walked, Jesus opened their minds to understand the Scriptures. Their hearts burned with hope.
steps.speaker: Narrator

steps.text: How did Jesus help the disciples understand?
options: By explaining the Scriptures about the Messiah
By telling stories about travels
By asking to borrow money
steps.answer: By explaining the Scriptures about the Messiah

steps.speaker: Disciple 1
steps.text: O stranger, the night is falling. Come and stay with us. Don't abandon us!
Jesus entered to stay with them. When they sat at the table, Jesus took the bread, blessed it, and gave it to them.
steps.speaker: Narrator

steps.text: At that moment, the eyes of the disciples were opened and they recognized Jesus. But he disappeared from their sight.
steps.speaker: Narrator
Disciple 2
steps.text: It was Jesus! Didn't our hearts burn when he spoke to us on the way and opened the Scriptures?

steps.speaker: Disciple 1
steps.text: Let's go back to Jerusalem! We must tell the others that Jesus has risen!
How did the disciples recognize Jesus?
options: When he broke bread at the table
When they heard his voice
When they saw him risen
steps.answer: When he broke bread at the table

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: The disciples returned to Jerusalem with joy. They found the other disciples and shared that Jesus had risen and revealed himself to them.
